CELIGO_API_HOST.title: Celigo region
CELIGO_API_HOST.description: API host for the region your integrator.io account lives in: api.integrator.io (US), api.eu.integrator.io (EU), api.au.integrator.io (AU), or api.ca.integrator.io (CA). Sign-in only works against your account's region. Defaults to US.
